top.badge: OPTIONAL META AI · REAL LOCAL AUDIO
intro.eyebrow: Build for Your World / Theatre and live events
intro.title: From script to approved cue
intro.description: Import a script, approve cues and play local audio with manual GO. Suggestions can be simulated or generated with Meta AI only after you configure the API and explicitly authorize sending an excerpt.
script.heading: Script
script.audioHint: Up to 20 MB · 10 min · mono/stereo. Reload audio after opening JSON.
proposals.heading: Proposals
proposals.help: Create manual test proposals or choose a Meta model provider if an API key is configured. No playback starts without human approval.
proposals.label: Cue description
proposals.metaNextButton: Analyze next scenes with Meta AI
proposals.metaDisclaimer: Each confirmation authorizes exactly one bounded Meta request containing one scene window, read-only context and 80 audio filenames. No WAV/MP3 files are sent. API usage may incur charges; requests are not retried automatically.
proposals.coverageNone: Scene coverage: no Meta analysis completed yet.

scriptLanguage.label: Script language for AI
scriptLanguage.help: Independent of interface language. Keeps the original script unchanged.
cues.heading: Cue list
cues.help: Create and edit cues freely. AI suggestions are optional. Selecting a cue never starts audio.
cues.scopeBody: TXT import, human review, local GO/STOP/FADE/STOP ALL and JSON export/import. Reload your audio files after closing or refreshing the page: audio is not embedded in JSON.
footer: Hackathon prototype · Local audio · Meta AI uses an external service only with consent · Save JSON to keep your changes

status.confirmMeta:
Authorize exactly one external, potentially billable Meta AI request?

This request covers scene window(s) {startWindow}–{endWindow} of {totalWindows}: {windowCount} window(s), {lineCount} target script line(s), bounded read-only context, and up to 80 audio filenames/IDs. No WAV/MP3 audio is sent. The request will not be retried automatically.

No cue will run automatically.

No WAV/MP3 files are sent. Requests may use paid credits. Baseten Muse Spark Open does not guarantee structured JSON; invalid answers are rejected.

status.confirmBaseten:
Authorize an external Baseten request?

To run Meta Muse Spark Open, up to 120 script lines (250 characters each) and 80 audio resource names/IDs will be sent to Baseten. No WAV/MP3 files will be sent. Your Baseten credits may be charged.

No cue will execute automatically.

errors.basetenRate: Baseten returned a request or credit limit. Check usage and limits before retrying.

audioProps.heading: Playback properties · real audio
audioProps.gainHelp: 0 dB is the existing safe -6 dB output. Only attenuation is available.
audioProps.repeatHelp: 1 to 20 consecutive plays. A loop repeats indefinitely.
audioProps.noAuto: These settings apply on the next manual GO. They never start a cue automatically. An end fade only applies to finite playback.
audioProps.saved: Playback settings saved for cue {number}. No audio was started.
audioProps.currentLimits: Playback supports trim, start offset, speed, stereo pan, delay, fades, loops, finite repeats and stopping/fading named earlier cues on manual GO. Independent PFL, timecode, multichannel outputs, pure STOP/FADE-only cues and automatic follow are not implemented yet.
audioProps.startAtHelp: Trim the beginning of the file. Must be less than its decoded duration.
audioProps.rateHelp: 1.0× preserves pitch/speed behavior; changing speed changes pitch in this browser.
audioProps.panHelp: -1 left, 0 center, +1 right. Depends on browser stereo output.
audioProps.stopTargets: On GO: stop other active cues
audioProps.stopTargetsHelp: Choose target cues and specify a fade-out duration for each. 0 seconds cuts immediately. The action happens only when you press GO; no Auto Follow.

cueEditor.discardChanges: You have unsaved cue edits. Discard them and change selection or inspector tab?
cueEditor.actionsSaved: Target-stop actions saved for cue {number}. No sound was started.
cueEditor.listHelp: Click a cue row to edit it. ↑ ↓ Home End navigate. Inspection never changes NEXT GO.
cueEditor.hint: Edit cue properties on the right. GO and emergency STOP remain in Operation.
cueEditor.saveEditsFirst: Save or discard the cue's pending inspector edits before exporting JSON or ZIP.

cueEditor.trackEditorPending: Audio attachment editing currently supports one PLAY track per cue; multi-track editing is a separate feature.
cueTracks.heading: Additional PLAY tracks
cueTracks.explanation: These tracks play together on the same manual GO. Each has its own audio, volume, delay, fades, loop, speed and panorama. The approved script proposal stays unchanged.
cueTracks.choose: Choose another audio file from the local library
cueTracks.removeConfirm: Remove this additional audio track? No audio will play.
cueTracks.libraryEmpty: Load audio into the local library first.

cueEditor.stopBeforeEdit: Stop all audio before changing the cue sequence.
cueEditor.sequenceChanged: Cue sequence updated. Next GO is positioned at the first cue.
